context.working_title: Zero-Trust Architecture for Microservices: A Production Guide
context.business_outcome: Build topical authority in backend security and infrastructure engineering.
context.audience: Senior Backend Engineers, DevOps, and Security Architects designing secure microservices.

topical_authority.information_gain: Real-world implementations of mTLS using SPIFFE/SPIRE, replacing static API keys with OAuth2.1 PKCE, and JWT validation in Go microservices.

keywords.cannibalization_check: Zero-trust was mentioned in MCP and Core Banking, but no dedicated deep-dive pillar exists.
keywords.serp_notes: Top results are highly theoretical (NIST definitions). Lacks practical code-level implementations for backend engineers.

geo_aeo.answer_first_block: Zero-Trust Architecture (ZTA) trong Microservices là mô hình bảo mật loại bỏ niềm tin mặc định vào mạng nội bộ. Mọi service-to-service communication đều phải được xác thực liên tục thông qua mTLS (workload identity) và user token (identity propagation) thay vì dùng API keys tĩnh.
query_fan_out: Làm sao để triển khai mTLS cho Microservices?
SPIFFE/SPIRE hoạt động như thế nào trong Zero-Trust?
Identity Propagation khác gì với Service Authentication?
